cve_summary: In FFmpeg 4.0.1, an improper argument (AVCodecParameters) passed to the avpriv_request_sample function in the handle_eac3 function in libavformat/movenc.c may trigger an out-of-array read while converting a crafted AVI file to MPEG4, leading to a denial of service and possibly an information disclosure.
commit_message:
avformat/movenc: Do not pass AVCodecParameters in avpriv_request_sample

Fixes: out of array read
Fixes: ffmpeg_crash_8.avi

Found-by: Thuan Pham, Marcel Böhme, Andrew Santosa and Alexandru Razvan Caciulescu with AFLSmart
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
docstring:
"""
Summary: 
Handles the parsing of EAC3 audio packets within a MOV container.

Parameters: 
mov (MOVMuxContext *): The MOV multiplexing context.
pkt (AVPacket *): The audio packet containing EAC3 data.
track (MOVTrack *): The track associated with the audio data.

Returns: 
int: The size of the processed packet on success, or an error code on failure.

Logic: 
The function first allocates memory for EAC3 private data if not already present. It then parses the EAC3 header from the packet data. If the header is invalid, it logs a warning and may drop the packet. The function checks for the validity of substream IDs and handles both independent and dependent substreams, updating the necessary information in the EAC3 structure. It manages the accumulation of packet data and ensures that the number of blocks does not exceed the limit. Finally, it returns the size of the processed packet or an error code if any issues arise during processing.
"""
